rendered: The NiTi wires were pulled in axial tension over a range of strains, 0−10%[1]. The strains that were applied and then locked in after unloading were 5% and 10%[2]. The Methods describe the straining as axial tensile deformation up to 5%[3] and 10% strains[4], with no deformation beyond that level so the coating would not delaminate.
